newsitem.title: BELARUS: SOCCER-BELARUS NAME TEAM FOR SWEDEN MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELARUS NAME TEAM FOR SWEDEN MATCH.

text.p: Belarus, with only pride to play for in their group four World Cup qualifier against Sweden on Wedneday, named a full-strength team on Friday.
Defender Sergei Lavrik, injured during the match with Scotland in June, has recovered after surgery and should be fit to play in Minsk.
Belarus are bottom of the group with just four points from six games while Sweden, still in contention for a place in the finals, are third on 12 points from six games.

Valery Shantalosov, Vycheslav Gerashchenko, Andrei Dovnar, Andrei Lavrik, Sergei Shtanyuk, Andrei Ostrovsky, Sergei Gurenko, Rodislav Orlovsky, Alexander Kulchiy, Miroslav Romashchenko, Sergei Gerasimets.
